latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor Online Generator (version 1.0.0):

- Instantly edit and generate videos online using simple text instructions—no software installation required.
- Supports video uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM).
- Fast cloud-based AI editing and export, delivering polished MP4s in 30–90 seconds.
- Seamless authentication with free anonymous token (100 credits, 7 days).
- Covers batch processing, timeline editing, and multiple export formats.
- Clear error handling with simple user guidance for common issues.
